name: Wide-Field Camera
description: Cheap, light and data-hungry. Good for context images.
whatItMeasures: Takes wide colour pictures of large areas: clouds, coastlines, big fields.

name: High-Resolution Telescope Camera
description: Needs very steady pointing and a fast downlink (200 Gbit/day).
whatItMeasures: Sees details down to about one metre: buildings, roads, single fields.

name: Multispectral Imager
description: The workhorse of farming and water monitoring.
whatItMeasures: Sees several colours, including invisible near-infrared, which reveals plant health and water.

name: Thermal Infrared Imager
description: Works day and night. Needs a cooler, so it uses 50 W.
whatItMeasures: Measures heat: soil dryness, cloud-top temperature, freezing dark craters.

name: Synthetic Aperture Radar
description: Powerful but heavy (150 kg) and power-hungry (400 W).
whatItMeasures: Sends radio pulses and builds images from the echoes; works at night and through clouds and dust.

name: Atmospheric Sounder
description: Best from an orbit that watches continuously.
whatItMeasures: Measures temperature and humidity at different heights: the main input for weather forecasts.

name: Lightning Mapper
description: Most useful staring at one region from far away.
whatItMeasures: Detects lightning flashes day and night, a sign that storms are strengthening.

name: Neutron Spectrometer
description: Light, low power, tiny data; does not need precise pointing.
whatItMeasures: Counts neutrons escaping from the ground. A dip means hydrogen: a strong hint of water ice.

name: Laser Altimeter
whatItMeasures: Fires laser pulses and times the echoes to map surface height very precisely.

name: Magnetometer
description: Almost free in mass, power and data. Small science value.
whatItMeasures: Measures magnetic fields around the planet and in space.

name: Atmospheric Spectrometer
description: Key for atmosphere studies on Earth and Mars.
whatItMeasures: Splits light into colours to identify gases like methane, carbon dioxide and water vapour.

name: Radiation & Particle Detector
description: Halves the damage risk from solar storms.
whatItMeasures: Counts energetic particles from the Sun; gives early warning of radiation storms.

name: Rover Relay Radio
description: Counts as an instrument; essential for Red Relay.
whatItMeasures: Collects data from rovers and landers and forwards it to Earth.

name: Cryogenic Infrared Telescope
description: Huge (400 kg), $250M, needs ±0.001° pointing and a cold, stable orbit.
whatItMeasures: A super-cold infrared telescope that sees heat from the most distant galaxies and from planets around other stars.
